notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: [p]I have been tracking the issue of the game crashing after Sami's death for a long time, but I still haven't been able to identify the source of the problem. I tried to resolve this situation by taking a different approach. I believe this update may have solved the problem. [/p][p]Your feedback is very important to me. I read all the videos and comments you share about Baron, and I'm trying to find a solution based on your collective requests for the early access version. I can say that a great early access version awaits you. Since I developed the demo version and early access version on my own, I offered the game to you as a demo (for free) to show that I have no ulterior motives, unlike certain games in the history of Turkish games. You mentioned that the demo was too dark, so I took that into consideration and updated the demo version with a brighter atmosphere. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849586/4f683d1aeaeb703aa1f792d9b3cfa64142075501.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Performance Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849586/0f85027726237ff391a1ecb383a34890b61d8281.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this update[/p][p]1- Performance increased by about 20%.[/p][p]2- Sami's health has been reduced by 80%.[/p][p]3- Adjusted the location of the guide widget showing how to unlock weapon attachments.[/p][p]The Minimum System Requirements for the Demo Version are as follows;[/p][p]* Intel Core-i5 2550K 3.4GHz / AMD FX 8120 3.1 GHz[/p][p]* 4 GB RAM[/p][p]* NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 GDDR5 / AMD RX 570 / RX 5500 XT[/p][p]* 12 GB available space[/p][p]Note: Low System Requirements are suitable for playing on the Lowest Settings (Performance Mode).[/p][p]Recommended Version System Requirements are as follows;[/p][p]* Intel Core-i7-10750H / AMD Ryzen 5 5600H[/p][p]* 8 GB RAM[/p][p]* NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 / Radeon RX 6600 XT[/p][p]* 12 GB available space[/p][p]Note: Recommended System Requirements are around 80 fps in Quality mode and 40 fps in Ultra Quality mode.[/p]

notes.title: Baron Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849586/8fb02d0a6589604821ced4b91b0018b1d15b4c2d.jpg[/img]

According to the feedback of those who played the demo, I decided to update the mechanics of the game and I plan to add and edit the following mechanics in early access;

1- I am updating the system of picking up items from the ground or picking up items that fall to the ground after killing the enemy. You will now be able to pick up items from the corpse of the enemy. As in every RPG game, you will kill the enemy, open his bag and get what you want.
2- Character camera angle will be updated
3- You will now be able to hold down the right button and shoot without aiming
4- Car driving mechanics have been added
5- I will bring a time limit to bandage usage. You will not be able to use infinite bandages all the time.
6- Multiple item crafting options will be added in the crafting tab
7- Interface will be updated
8- The number of bullets in your inventory will now appear above the current magazine capacity in weapons. In this way, you will be able to see how many bullets you have left.
9- Focus ability will be linked to stamina and will consume stamina. It cannot be used unlimitedly.
10- New weapons have been added
11- 5km2 Ankara-Gölbaşı map continues to be modeled.
12- Fishing mechanics will be added to distract and earn a little money in the game
13- Bosses will have the same health as normal enemies, but it will be more difficult to reach them.
14- It will be completely open world. Except for the outer borders of the map, you will be able to reach every part of the map without access barriers.
15- You will be able to do missions without loading screen
16- Registration system has been added. Respawn points will now be added to certain areas of the map and you will be able to respawn there when you die according to your choice.
17- The settings menu is completely renewed.
18- You will start from the character Alparslan before he met the mafia and you will be able to buy weapons as you progress.
19- The crosshair has been updated and a more interactive crosshair has been added.
20- The 1-2-3-4-5-6-7-8 bars at the bottom have been removed and only the health and stamina bars are visible.
21- Main and side story missions will be added. You will be able to communicate with NPCs and direct the course of the story according to the choices you make. The choices you make will affect the course of the story.
22- Full controller support will be available. MAC users will now be able to access the game. 
23- English - German - French - Italian - Chinese and Japanese language support will be added.
24- I also have plans to add CO-OP mode. You will be able to play a private story mode with 4 friends, but CO-OP mode will be added in the future. After 3 months of the early access release, I will decide whether or not to add CO-OP mode based on the revenue generated.
